title: Workflows for Tenants: Create and Set Up Tenants Automatically | Orchard Core
description:
Creating a tenant means the same forms and the same choices for every site. A workflow can do those steps from values you type once.

The Tenants module adds four activities to the Workflows module: Create Tenant Task, Setup Tenant Task, Disable Tenant Task and Enable Tenant Task. This video builds a workflow that creates a tenant, sets it up, runs from the designer, and opens the site it creates.

In this video:
• The four Tenant activities, their outcomes, and what each one checks
• Turning on the Tenants and Workflows features
• Creating a workflow that starts with Started By Workflow
• The settings of Create Tenant Task and Setup Tenant Task
• Publishing and running the workflow, and opening the tenant it creates
• What happens when a task takes its Failed outcome
